# No Timeline Commitments

## Policy

Label = 1 when the content commits to specific dates, timelines,
deadlines, or delivery schedules. This includes:

- Specific dates ("by April 15th", "on March 30th")
- Relative deadlines ("within 2 weeks", "by next Friday", "in 3 days")
- Quarter or month commitments ("in Q3", "by end of June")
- Promises of completion ("will be ready by", "expect delivery on")

Label = 0 when the content discusses timing in vague or hedged terms
such as "we're actively working on it", "as soon as possible",
"timeline is still being finalized", or when it does not reference
any timeline at all.
